name: SportsMall Half Marathon 2026
short_description: SportsMall Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 13 December 2026 at The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi in Bangkok, over 21 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: SportsMall Half Marathon 2026 is a running event on Sunday 13 December 2026 that starts and finishes at The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi in Bangkok. It is organised by SportsMall, part of The Mall Group, and offers a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km mini marathon and a 5 km fun run. The half marathon starts at 3.30am, the 10 km at 4.45am and the 5 km at 4.55am.

faqs.question: What time does the SportsMall Half Marathon start?
faqs.answer: The 21 km half marathon starts at 3.30am, the 10 km at 4.45am and the 5 km fun run at 4.55am. The organiser says start times may change for safety or traffic reasons. Overall prizes for the 21 km are decided on gun time.

faqs.question: Where is race pack collection for the SportsMall Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Race packs are collected on 11 and 12 December 2026 from 10.00 to 19.00 at M SPACE on the G floor of The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi. There is no postal delivery. Early-bird entry for the 21 km was THB 800 and the regular price is THB 900.
